cases.baseline_red: Cut13: tab hiding rolls back drag but retains multi-click shape draft
cases.fix: Cancel incomplete draft upon document hidden and window blur, without recording document history
cases.evidence: browser_cut14.py: hidden event while segment draft active, next click cannot complete stale segment

cases.baseline_red: Cut13: delayed file.text() can finish after an identical-content New, because documentRevision alone remains unchanged
cases.fix: Guard delayed JSON import using both documentRevision and documentGeneration
cases.evidence: browser_cut14.py: controllable File.text promise plus New and delayed resolve

cases.baseline_red: Cut13: isComposing Delete can trigger global object deletion and composing Escape can close tikz-cd import
cases.fix: Short-circuit global key handling before modal and destructive shortcut logic when composing or keyCode=229
cases.evidence: browser_cut14.py: synthetic composition events, object preserved, import modal stays open; ordinary Escape still closes

cases.evidence: browser_cut14.py: drag then zoom before pointerup, original coordinates preserved
